frame: Origin at the centre of the plate's bottom face. X runs along the width, Y along the length, Z up through the thickness.

parameters.name: slot_length
parameters.description: Overall length of the centred through-slot (along X, end to end)

edit_rules: Each of the 4 holes stays 10 mm from the two nearest outer edges when width or length changes.
All 4 holes go through the full thickness and share one diameter (hole_diameter).
If present, the slot stays centred on the plate, runs along X and goes through the full thickness.
